name: manual_1103c6
claim: When a local episodic/memory branch reports ahead-of-origin by a small N, identify the exact commits, check reachability from main and the active consolidation branch, and compare patch-id/content before assuming unmerged feature work — local closeout memory often sits only on a stale tip after related PRs already merged.

decisions.notes: Verified on 2026-08-03-001-periscope-fts5-tag-lesson: two ahead commits were .agent episodic-only, not in main or consolidation; rehabilitating required content union onto the active branch rather than a history-rewrite narrative.
